discussion.body: Rook Fenn. Main-side. Meddos alleys, Timshaw ledgers. Knives, locks, debts. Joins Act 1 because the Gate writ is worth more to the party than to the fence. Death crises: Timshaw levy riot (Act 1) if the party starts the fire; Act 5 camp raid if he is sent alone at the powder. Default lives. Contingency: the writ and his town maps persist as items; a Timshaw kid can pick a later lock worse. Not romance-gated. If dead, Act 4 Cove still functions through Nym or a dock NPC.
